sections.briefing_title_en: AI and Large Models: Self-Improving Agents, Product Deployment, and Research Governance
sections.briefing_summary_en: This edition covers new papers and product moves in AI and large models. On frontier models, ClawLoop and Harness^2 explore self-improvement for LLM agents through a harness-native training loop and recursive execution harnessing, Echo uses error-compensated 4-bit tensor-parallel communication to cut all-reduce costs, and another paper asks whether LLMs can access world knowledge for event prediction. On products and platforms, Amp uses OpenAI models to extend agents beyond coding, Apate sends agents undercover to get scammed and gather fraud intelligence, and Floqer uses agents to research sales prospects for B2B revenue teams. On research and governance, items span an LLM-referenced C-test for superintelligence, Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0, welfare-aware preference acquisition for pluralistic alignment, silent failures in agentic data science, and unconstrained evaluation of open-weight models on CTI-REALM.

subsections.briefing_title_en: Frontier Models: Self-Improving Agents, Communication Optimization, and Event Prediction
subsections.briefing_summary_en: The frontier models subsection covers four arXiv papers. ClawLoop lets LLM-based agents self-improve through a harness-native training loop in sandbox workspaces, improving their use of tools such as file systems and shells. Harness^2 proposes recursive self-improvement to automatically evolve execution harnesses for LLM agents and discusses two challenges in open-world settings. Echo uses error-compensated 4-bit tensor-parallel communication to cut all-reduce costs in LLM training and inference and ease interconnect bandwidth bottlenecks. Another paper asks whether LLMs truly cannot access pretrained world knowledge to predict events, or whether current methods fail to present the event prediction task effectively.

subsections.briefing_title_en: Research and Governance: Superintelligence Tests, Long-Horizon Benchmarks, and Pluralistic Alignment
subsections.briefing_summary_en: The research and governance subsection summarizes five arXiv papers. One proposes an LLM-referenced C-test to evaluate machines that may surpass current systems and test designers, avoiding benchmarks that become circular or saturate quickly. Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0 extends a long-horizon terminal benchmark, retaining 46 original tasks while automating diverse task construction and using process rewards to measure whether agents sustain progress through workflows. Another paper studies welfare-aware preference acquisition for pluralistic alignment under limited human feedback, using AI simulators while accounting for varying simulation accuracy so diverse preferences are better represented in alignment training. A further paper examines evaluation of LLM data science agents from task formulation to model development, arguing that final outcomes alone miss silent failures in the process. The last compares open-weight models with expensive closed frontier models on the CTI-REALM benchmark, studying trade-offs for organizations choosing auditable language-model agents for security work.

articles.reason_en: Reports a scientific assessment of common workout recovery methods, fitting health and medicine research.

articles.title: 成年后运动更轻松的秘密可能始于童年

articles.title_en: The secret to easier exercise as an adult may start in childhood
articles.summary_en: A study with guinea fowl found birds accustomed to carrying weights while growing up could carry them as adults without extra energy, while untrained birds burned 23% more, suggesting childhood exercise may have lifelong metabolic benefits.
articles.original_title: The secret to easier exercise as an adult may start in childhood
articles.reason: 基于动物实验的运动生理研究，揭示童年运动对成年能量消耗的长期影响。
articles.reason_en: Animal-study exercise physiology research on long-term effects of childhood activity.

articles.title: 被遗忘的化石揭示一种长巨爪的可怕恐龙
articles.summary: 一块被遗忘近百年、距今约1.2亿年的化石揭示了一种新恐龙。这种老虎大小的掠食者长有巨爪，是欧洲首次发现的大盗龙类证据，有助于解释该类群如何演化成巨型猎手。
articles.title_en: A forgotten fossil reveals a fearsome dinosaur with giant claws
articles.summary_en: A 120-million-year-old fossil forgotten in a museum for nearly a century reveals a new tiger-sized dinosaur with giant claws, the first evidence of megaraptorans in Europe, helping explain how these dinosaurs became giant hunters.

articles.reason_en: A new paleontology discovery, directly fitting scientific research.

articles.title: 康奈尔科学家在两只异常长腿的猫中发现罕见人类遗传病
articles.summary: 两只异常长腿的猫帮助康奈尔大学研究人员首次在家猫中基因确诊马凡综合征。这对猫兄弟携带与该结缔组织疾病相关的两个变异基因拷贝，该病可影响眼睛、心脏和血管。
articles.title_en: Cornell scientists identify rare human genetic disorder in two unusually long-legged cats
articles.summary_en: Two unusually long-legged cats helped Cornell University researchers uncover the first genetically confirmed cases of Marfan syndrome in domestic felines; the brothers carried two altered copies of a gene linked to the connective tissue disorder.
articles.original_title: Cornell scientists identify rare human genetic disorder in two unusually long-legged cats
articles.reason: 遗传学与兽医学研究，揭示猫中的人类相关遗传病。
articles.reason_en: Genetics and veterinary research revealing a human-related genetic disorder in cats.
